added_lemmas.justification: This question isolates the exact effective geometric package still needed to turn coherent recession operators into a finite globally honest search space.
added_lemmas.gap: The standing assumptions do not yet yield simultaneous canonical-section safety, collar compatibility, translated-uniform tails, or a refinement schedule whose total ledger vanishes.
added_lemmas.consumer: Only an affirmative answer, or a separately proved sufficient gluing package, can supply the displayed premise of the conditional CertGluePFL termination theorem.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct, or refute by a specific encoded experiment, a finite shared-trace recession library satisfying all five sufficient obligations in the question with an input-computable vanishing schedule.
obligation.obstruction: Finite rational active-set analysis proves forward distance monotonicity from a fixed mean but not canonical-section preservation of every active semantic region or the separated-risk set throughout protected stars. Shared mesh variables agree on geometric faces but do not control every candidate with positive weight on simultaneous collars. The guard and normal-base tails are not uniform over all translated means, and no current bound on the number of refined charged cells makes the cumulative discrepancy vanish.
obligation.attempted: A single Gaussian-smoothed ancestor, a common rational simplicial recession refinement, shared raywise Foelner factors, and barycentric shared-face variables establish a commuting operator cocycle and exact equality of finite-element traces only on geometric faces. An inductive lower-skeleton extension and slow collars were examined, but restricting an already-glued rule would be circular and constant lower-skeleton extension can activate unsafe candidates. Classical invariant-mean and Foelner theory does not supply the missing effective branching-poset estimates.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The asserted global construction is not established under the standing assumptions. The orchestrator requires replacing this unreachable theorem by the explicit open-ended construction question, while downstream theorem owners remove the former unconditional dependency rather than treating the question as proved.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Construct, or refute by a specific encoded experiment, a finite shared-trace recession library satisfying canonical-section preservation, safety of every positive-weight candidate, simultaneous-collar compatibility, translated-uniform tails, and an input-computable refinement schedule with vanishing accumulated error.
open_obligations.obstruction: The available active-set geometry controls only forward motion from a fixed mean. It does not preserve every active semantic region and the separated-risk set on canonical sections throughout protected stars. Face-vertex equality does not bound actual face--cone differences over collar overlap, and neither translated-uniform tail control nor a refinement-count recurrence is available.
open_obligations.attempted: The prior construction used one smoothed ancestor, one common rational simplicial fan, literally shared raywise Foelner factors, and shared finite-element face variables. These yield path-independent operators and translation boundary ratios, but the proposed collar induction becomes circular if it defines traces from the glued rule and may be unsafe under constant extension. No further generic averaging argument closes the branching-incidence estimates.

prose_updates.tldr: The unconditional contribution consists of three proved pieces: common-ray Foelner operators are path-independent and have explicit translation boundary ratios; Carter's bounded-ratio kernels yield fixed-compact and moving-offset multinomial transfer after separate semantic and covariance charges; and compact exhaustion yields a global lower limit together with two-sided convergence on computable expanding windows, but no global upper limit. Effective compatible density is now an open-ended question, and CertGluePFL termination remains conditional on an affirmative answer or a separately proved sufficient gluing package.

project_justification.gap: Carter's bounded-ratio comparison controls a fixed positive-cell multinomial experiment and its matched Gaussian experiment, but it does not compare moving causal truth regions or control parameters escaping every compact. At recession, common-ray commutativity does not control the Gaussian-weighted difference between incident face and cone rules on simultaneous collars. The remaining open question is whether the encoded rational geometry admits computable canonical-section safety, positive-weight candidate safety, translated-uniform tails, and a refinement schedule with total error tending to zero.
project_justification.niche: Finite-label partial-identification inference combines discontinuous completed labels, intersecting unbounded recession faces, and a global honesty constraint. Exact agreement on a geometric face does not control all candidates mixed nearby, while compact local asymptotics cannot detect a hard seam escaping to infinity. The proved compact/windowed transfer and the unresolved noncompact gluing problem are therefore mathematically distinct.
project_justification.fill: The paper solves common-ray operator coherence, Carter-based fixed-compact and moving-offset transfer with separate semantic and covariance error terms, a global minimax lower limit, and two-sided convergence on computable expanding windows. It does not prove global effective compatible density. That construction is posed explicitly as an open-ended question, and CertGluePFL termination is claimed only under an affirmative ECD result or a separately proved sufficient gluing package.

prose_updates.related_work: Carter (2002, Theorem 1 and Sections 2--6) supplies only the bounded-ratio comparison between fixed positive-cell multinomial experiments and their matched multivariate normal experiments through parameter-independent kernels. The present work separately handles score maps, covariance replacement, completed-affine-arrangement stability, moving offsets, and expanding lawful windows. Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes (2013) provide the Job Corps wage-effect partial-identification setting; that causal application does not supply recession gluing. Day and Markov--Kakutani invariant-mean theory and Namioka's 1964 Foelner conditions concern a single amenable commuting action and provide neither an input-computable modulus nor semantic coverage, separated-risk safety, translated-tail control, or branching-refinement complexity.
prose_updates.interpretation: The Gaussian experiment is the valid local decision target on every fixed lawful direction window. Its minimax value is the limit of the expanding-window multinomial values and a lower limit for the original global values; the compact-uniform premises imply no global upper limit. The common-ray library is an algebraically coherent recession representation, not a compatibility-density theorem. The missing step is simultaneous safe gluing across actual collar supports with a computable growing-refinement ledger.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: Effective compatible density is unresolved under the standing assumptions. The missing construction must preserve every active \(D_v\), \(H_r\), and protected star on canonical sections; certify every candidate with positive collar weight; prove exact overlap traces or an honest Gaussian-weighted face--cone discrepancy bound on simultaneous supports; control guard and normal-base tails uniformly over translated means; and compute refinement counts \(N_j\) and schedules \(L_j,B_j,\delta_j\) for which all accumulated errors vanish and \(N_j/L_j\to0\). No refinement-independent ledger constant is assumed. Consequently the milliscale four-label certificate and unconditional global CertGluePFL termination also remain unresolved.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The causal target is the same-law joint identified set and is only contained in the product of coordinatewise sharp endpoint intervals; no Cartesian joint sharpness is claimed. Carter-backed sampled-data results are fixed-compact or expanding-window statements. Compact exhaustion proves the global lower limit and two-sided windowed convergence, but neither a global \(\limsup\) nor a globally honest unbounded sampled-data primal. Common-ray coherence, Gaussian smoothing, one-chart averaging, and fixed-library weighted telescoping are proved. Global effective compatible density is an open-ended question, so CertGluePFL termination and replayable global Gaussian certification are conditional rather than established.
